main_agent.responsibility: Single controlling agent for the full workflow. It assigns stage work to subordinate agents, decides whether the workflow may advance, and generates the final integrated report and interpretation.

stage_preflight_agent.responsibility: Subordinate stage agent or skill. It validates input files, stage config, tool availability, and readiness before execution.

stage_execution_agent.responsibility: Subordinate stage agent or skill. It executes the deterministic stage command after preflight passes and persists execution metadata.

stage_review_agent.responsibility: Subordinate stage agent or skill. It checks whether the stage ran correctly and whether the outputs are valid enough for the next stage.

stage_report_agent.responsibility: Subordinate stage agent or skill. It generates a mini report and mini interpretation for the current stage using inputs, run details, and outputs.

implementation_support.responsibility: Optional implementation and debugging support for code/config changes around the pipeline.

codex.notes: Optional external Codex adapter. If disabled, the builtin deterministic implementation remains canonical.

claude.notes: Optional external Claude adapter for scientific/method review.

qwen.notes: Optional external Qwen adapter for adversarial input/output validation.

cursor.notes: Optional Cursor/IDE adapter for implementation-side assistance.
